# Damage

Source: [7025](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/7025); edited 2025-09-09. Evidence: archived documentation.

Not independently verified in the current game. An article edit date is not a behavioral test date.

Exact pinned API: [Damage](../../api/actions/damage.md).

<a id="wiki-7025-n1"></a>

- Damage amount is subject to buffs, debuffs, and armor; Null damager means nobody receives credit.

<a id="wiki-7025-n2"></a>

- Checking Is Using Ultimate during a damage event does not identify that damage as ultimate damage; the article explicitly notes this limitation.

Source limitations:

- First example supplies a player array where Damager is documented as a single player and claims credit goes to all; not established.

- Mercy example claims its loop stops when healing ends but includes no conditions, so the claimed termination is unsupported by the shown code.
